# spc-ema-epar (PHAROS fixture)

EMA medicines JSON report, https://www.ema.europa.eu/en/documents/report/medicines-output-medicines_json-report_en.json,
read 5 November 2026 (2,754 rows, 6.8 MB). `medicines_json_slice.json` keeps the `meta` object and six
rows copied verbatim: the three ibuprofen rows (two Authorised, one Application withdrawn) and the
first human row with status Refused, Opinion and Withdrawn. The `...-json-report_en.json` and
`...-medicines-report_en.json` spellings both answered 404 that day.
